description: Tecentriq as monotherapy is indicated as adjuvant treatment following complete resection and platinum-based chemotherapy for adult patients with NSCLC with a high risk of recurrence whose tumours have PD-L1 expression on >= 50% of tumour cells (TC) and who do not have EGFR mutant or ALK-positive NSCLC.
